subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill In the blank**.

Several peoples’ homes were badly _______ during the floods.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Damaged**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The most appropriate word is 'Damaged.'
 
 
• 
 The **meaning** of 'Damaged' is 'to spoil or harm something.' (किसी चीज को खराब करना।)

 
 
• 
 **For example,** *The roof was damaged by the storm.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the correct option is **2**.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 
 Let's know the meaning of the other words:
 

 
 

 
 **Word**
 
 
 **Meaning**
 
 
 

 
 Drowned 
 
 
 to die by being underwater and unable to breathe. (पानी के भीतर रहने और सांस लेने में असमर्थ होने से मरना।)
 
 
 

 
 Drained
 
 
 to make something dry or empty. (कुछ सूखा या खाली करना।)
 
 
 

 
 Deluged
 
 
 to cover something with a lot of water. (बहुत सारे पानी से किसी चीज को ढंकना।)
